entries.english: Disputes over sheep driving and pasturing in the (possibly) Creglingen administrative district. In 1493, disputes arose between Cuntz Schäfer of Oberickelsheim and Asinus von Rosenberg, Ritter, and between the shepherd’s widow Ursula of Creglingen and the von Rosenberg subjects at Rinderfeld and Streichental. The file also records a dispute between the community of Obernbreit and the shepherd in 1505, and the shepherd of Oberickelheim’s grazing payment in 1510. The archival heading tentatively identifies the district as a Kastenamt.
